comments.body: This file add tools to the panel. It needs further review/modification after we start working on tools. Please ignore this file for now.

code_window:
1  import PanelManager_ from '../PanelManager_/PanelManager_'
     2  import { TOOL_ORIENTATION } from './types/tool'
     3  import { PANEL_POSITION } from '../PanelManager_/types/layout'
     4  
     5  const ToolControllerModern_ = {
     6      /**
     7       * Generate tool metadata from mission config tool definition
     8       * This is a mock implementation until proper tool metadata is available
     9       *
    10       * @param {Object} toolConfig - Tool configuration from mission config
    11       * @param {string} toolConfig.name - Tool name
    12       * @param {string} toolConfig.icon - Tool icon
    13       * @param {string} toolConfig.js - Tool JS module name
    14       * @returns {Object} Tool metadata object
    15       */
    16      generateToolMetadata: function (toolConfig) {
    17          // Default tool metadata based on common patterns
    18          const toolName = toolConfig.name || 'Unknown'
    19          const toolId = toolConfig.js || toolName.toLowerCase().replace(/\s+/g, '-')
    20  
    21          // Mock metadata - In the future, this should come from the tool's actual metadata
    22          return {
    23              id: toolId,
    24              name: toolName,
    25              // Most tools can adapt to any orientation for now
    26              // This should be refined based on actual tool requirements
    27              requiredOrientation: TOOL_ORIENTATION.ANY,
    28              icon: toolConfig.icon || 'cog',
    29              // Tools can be placed in any position by default
    30              compatiblePositions: undefined
    31          }
    32      },
    33  
    34      /**
    35       * Build tool configuration maps for efficient lookup
    36       * @param {Array} tools - Array of tool configurations
    37       * @returns {Object} Object containing toolConfigMap and getToolData helper
    38       */
    39      buildToolConfigMap: function (tools) {
    40          const toolConfigMap = new Map() // id -> { config, metadata }
    41          const toolNameToId = new Map() // name -> id
    42  
    43          tools.forEach(toolConfig => {
    44              const toolMetadata = ToolControllerModern_.generateToolMetadata(toolConfig)
    45  
    46              // Store by ID (primary key)
    47              if (toolConfigMap.has(toolMetadata.id)) {
    48                  console.warn(`[Modern Layout] Duplicate tool ID detected: ${toolMetadata.id}`)
    49              }
    50              toolConfigMap.set(toolMetadata.id, { config: toolConfig, metadata: toolMetadata })
    51
